subject: 2026 review cycle: playbook draft, timeline, and manager comms
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Emma Carter <emma@peopleops-consulting.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: 2026 review cycle: playbook draft, timeline, and manager comms

Hi all —

I'm circulating a first draft of the 2026 performance review playbook, the proposed timeline, and the manager comms we plan to send next month. High level goals: keep the cycle predictable, reduce administrative load on managers, and tighten calibration to reduce rating drift.

Attachments: 2026-review-forms-v2.pdf, manager-calibration-agenda.docx
Drive: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1rExampleDriveLinkReviewPlaybook

Proposed timeline (high level):
- Mar 24: Manager kickoffs + release of manager packet
- Apr 7: Self-assessments due from ICs
- Apr 21: Manager reviews complete
- Apr 28-May 1: Manager calibration sessions (two waves)
- May 6: Compensation calibration meeting (leadership + HR)
- May 10: Final ratings locked / communications to employees

Notes / asks:
- Marcus & Marissa: please review the manager packet and highlight any questions or missing guidance by end of week (Mar 13).
- Monica: confirm the DocuSign flow for manager attestations and share a timeline for payroll handoff.
- Emma: any red flags on the forms for regulated teams or accommodations?

Manager comms draft excerpt included in the attachment — should be short and action-oriented. We will send the employee-facing comm after we finalize dates next week.

Thanks —
Laura Bennett
Senior Engineering Manager, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com

---

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Emma Carter <emma@peopleops-consulting.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Mar 2026 10:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: 2026 review cycle: playbook draft, timeline, and manager comms

Thanks Laura — solid starting point. A few quick thoughts: 

- Can we compress manager review -> calibration to reduce the window for rating gaming? Consider moving manager reviews due to Apr 14 and having calibration Apr 20–22.
- Please add a short section on compensation guidelines and the escalation path for borderline cases (up/down-grade, high-perf exceptions). I copied Monica for that.
- For leadership: let's run a 90-minute compensation calibration rather than an open-ended meeting; we should circulate pre-reads (summary of recommended changes) 48 hours prior.

Happy to join the calibration sessions; I think 2 waves is right (EMs + senior managers in wave 1, directors in wave 2).

-Vivek
VP, Product & Operations
vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com

Subject: Re: 2026 review cycle: playbook draft, timeline, and manager comms

Laura — thanks for pulling this together. A couple of clarifying Qs: 

1) Calibration participants: Do we have a headcount cap per session? Last year we had too many people in the same room and it derailed. I prefer 10–12 participants max with one facilitator.
2) Wave suggestion: Could we run an extra EM-only calibration on Apr 19 (short, 60 min) before the full group? EMs tend to have the most granular context and it helps distill recommendations before directors weigh in.

If we go with Vivek's compressed dates (reviews due Apr 14), I can shift my team's self-assessment deadline to Apr 3. I'll review the manager packet and leave comments in the Drive by Friday.

-Marissa
Engineering Manager
marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com

Adding a few compliance and ops notes from HR side: 

- DocuSign / attestations: we'll route a manager attestation (review completed, conflicts declared) via DocuSign immediately after calibrations. Target: managers complete attestations within 48 hours.
- Payroll handoff: please note the payroll blackout for comp changes is May 14–17; final comp inputs must be in the system by May 12 COB.
- Forms: the attached 2026-review-forms-v2.pdf has an accommodations checkbox and language for regulated projects (required by legal). Emma, the forms include the accommodation flow you suggested — anything else?

Attachments: 2026-review-forms-v2.pdf, comp-calibration-guidelines.pdf

Operational asks:
- Laura: once dates are locked, HR will create calendar blocks and enable the calibration meeting rooms + Zoom links.
- Marcus: can you coordinate a facilitator for the EM-only calibration (Apr 19) if we go that route?

Thanks —
Monica Patel
Senior People Operations Partner

Thanks everyone for quick feedback — summary and next steps below.

Decisions:
- We will adopt Vivek's compressed window: Manager reviews due Apr 14; calibration Apr 19–22 (EM-only calibration Apr 19, full group Apr 21–22).
- Compensation calibration will be May 6 (90-minute session). Pre-reads will be distributed by May 4.
- HR/DocuSign flow confirmed: managers complete attestations within 48 hours of their calibration session; payroll cutoff May 12.

Action items (owners & deadlines):
- Laura: finalize manager packet, incorporate Marissa's facilitator note, and upload final docs to the Drive by Mar 15. (Attachment: manager-calibration-agenda.docx)
- Monica: create calendar events and DocuSign flow; confirm payroll deadline in Workday by Mar 17.
- Marcus: confirm facilitator for Apr 19 by Mar 16.
- Marissa: leave comments in the Drive on the manager packet by Mar 13.
- Emma: review final forms and confirm regulated-team language by Mar 15.

I'll send a polished manager kickoff email and an employee-facing FAQ once the packet is finalized. Calendar invites will follow from People Ops.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Senior Engineering Manager, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com
